errors.title: Agent or host unavailable
causes: agent process down or network partition to the host
host group member decommissioned; check `ctm config server:agents`

errors.title: Job ended not-ok (OSCOMPSTAT / exit status)
causes: the underlying command/script failed - check the job output
exit-code handling: job may need explicit OnDo / OK-criteria rules

errors.title: Deploy validation error
causes: definition fails site-standard or schema validation
run `ctm build` locally; check field names against the API version

errors.title: Job not submitted / held
causes: upstream event/condition never arrived - check producers
job held manually or by a site standard

errors.title: SLA / service delay
causes: critical path running past the deadline window
upstream job retrying or waiting on a late condition

errors.title: Automation API / authorization failure
causes: expired or missing API token; renew via `ctm session login`
endpoint/environment name wrong in deploy descriptor
